title: Active Infants
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

There are $N$ children standing in a line from left to right. The activeness of the $i$-th child from the left is $A_i$.

You can rearrange these children just one time in any order you like.

When a child who originally occupies the $x$-th position from the left in the line moves to the $y$-th position from the left, that child earns $A_x \times |x-y|$ happiness points.

Find the maximum total happiness points the children can earn.

## Constraints

- $2 \leq N \leq 2000$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$
- All values in input are integers.

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
A_1 A_2 ... A_N
```

## Output

Print the maximum total happiness points the children can earn.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

有 $N$ 个孩子从左到右站成一排。第 $i$ 个孩子的活跃度为 $A_i$。

你可以将这些孩子按照任意顺序重新排列一次。

当原本位于从左数第 $x$ 个位置的孩子移动到从左数第 $y$ 个位置时，该孩子可以获得 $A_x \times |x-y|$ 点幸福值。

请找出孩子们能够获得的幸福值总和的最大值。

## 约束条件

- $2 \leq N \leq 2000$
- $1 \leq A_i \leq 10^9$
- 输入中的所有值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入中按以下格式给出：

```
N
A_1 A_2 ... A_N
```

## 输出格式

输出孩子们能够获得的幸福值总和的最大值。

samples.note: If we move the $1$-st child from the left to the $3$-rd position from the left, the $2$-nd child to the $4$-th position, the $3$-rd child to the $1$-st position, and the $4$-th child to the $2$-nd position, the children earns $1 \times |1-3|+3 \times |2-4|+4 \times |3-1|+2 \times |4-2|=20$ happiness points in total.
